description:
Change a scheduled or draft post. DESTRUCTIVE WRITE. Edit (default): caption, media, schedule, post_type, or settings; overwrites the existing post; cannot edit published or currently publishing posts; if a client has already approved the post, a caption edit reopens caption approval, a media or thumbnail edit reopens asset approval, and a reschedule, account change or settings change reopens both. status (scheduled, paused, or draft, with scheduled_at when scheduling a draft): pause, resume, or move back to draft; send it on its own. release_id (with optional group_id): set or repair external release/group IDs; send it on its own. approval_action (request, approve, request_changes, or reject): change client approval. Only a workspace owner or admin may do this. The actor is the API key user, never a brand guest. request emails the brand reviewers. approve, request_changes, and reject are team-side decisions. request_changes needs approval_note. Optional approval_axis is asset or caption; omit it for both. Send approval_action on its own.

REQUIRED BEFORE CALLING: Show the user a side-by-side of the CURRENT post (caption, scheduled time, media, status) and the PROPOSED change, and get explicit confirmation ("yes update it", "apply those changes") before calling. Do not auto-edit posts based on a general instruction - each change needs its own confirmation.

approval_action.description: Change client approval instead of editing the post. Send on its own.

approval_axis.description: With approval_action approve, request_changes, or reject: which axis to decide. Omit for both. Not allowed with request.

approval_note.description: Note stored with the approval change. Required for request_changes.

confirm.description: Must be true after explicit user confirmation of the proposed change.

group_id.description: With release_id only: an external group/campaign ID.

instagram_settings.description: Instagram-specific updates. Distinguish caption @mentions, native media user_tags, and collaborators. Native media tags work with eligible direct or Meta-linked accounts; collaborators require an eligible Meta-linked account. Call list_platforms with view=schema and account_id first.

audio_id.description: Licensed Instagram audio ID for Reels. Meta-linked Facebook Login accounts only.

caption_addon.description: Optional Instagram caption add-on. type is none, poll, or comment_prompt. A poll needs 2 to 4 options of 1 to 25 characters (an emoji counts as one) and the caption is the question. A comment prompt uses the caption as the prompt. Facebook Login only. Not available on Stories. At most one add-on per post. Pass null or type none to clear it.

collaborators.description: Native Instagram co-author invitations. Meta-linked accounts only; feed images, Reels, and carousels; not Stories.

is_ai_generated.description: Label the parent Instagram media container as AI-generated. For carousels, set on the parent only.

is_comment_prompt_used.description: Set true to attach an Instagram comment prompt. The caption is the prompt. Mutually exclusive with a poll. Facebook Login only. Not available on Stories.

is_poll_duration_extended.description: Set true only together with a poll, to request the longer Instagram poll duration.

media_accessibility.description: Preferred ordered media alt text. Identity follows index/asset_id through platform media preparation; media_alt_texts remains the legacy URL-map form.

poll_attachment.description: Instagram poll choices. option_a and option_b are required, option_c and option_d are optional, and option_d requires option_c. Mutually exclusive with a comment prompt. The caption is the question. Serialised JSON must be 200 characters or fewer.

user_tags.description: Native clickable media tags, not caption @mentions. Supported by eligible direct Instagram and Meta-linked connections; feed images, Reels/video, and Stories. Tags apply to each carousel item and the first Story in a Story Series.

media_url.description: New media URL. Posterly storage URLs are used as-is; third-party URLs are copied into posterly storage first. Short-lived signed URLs must still be live when this tool runs.

media_urls.description: New media URLs for carousel, handled like media_url.

platform_settings.description: Platform-specific settings to merge into the post. Prefer this over raw metadata.

media_accessibility.description: Preferred ordered media alt text. Identity follows index/asset_id through platform media preparation; media_alt_texts remains the legacy URL-map form.

post_type.description: New post type: text, image, video, carousel, reel, story, story_series, document, photo, or cover_photo

reel_cover_method.description: How the reel cover is chosen, e.g. an uploaded image or a frame offset.

reel_cover_url.description: Cover image URL for a reel.

reel_thumb_offset.description: Frame offset in milliseconds to use as the reel cover.

release_id.description: Set an external release ID instead of editing the post. Send with post_id and optional group_id only.

status.description: Change the post status instead of editing it. Send with post_id (and scheduled_at when scheduling a draft) only.

name: update_post
